title: DOE holds the nation's most important secrets
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of DOE holds the nation's most important secrets, about 2005-2008 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I learned some of this nation's most important secrets [music] at DOE, not CIA. DOE does stuff that man

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, introduced on Jesse Michels' podcast as a former chief at the CIA, the US spy agency, says that from 2005 to 2008 he worked at the Department of Energy, the US government department that oversees the country's nuclear sites. He says he learned some of the nation's most important secrets there, not at the CIA, hinting that the department does work few people imagine.
